title: RV & Boat Storage Rent Adjustment Terms
content:
A rent increase on an RV & Boat Storage space is made by written rate notice and takes effect within the following terms.

**Term 1 — rate lock.** Rent is not increased during the first rate-lock months of the rental. A rent increase may be noticed only after the rate-lock months counted from the rental start date. The rate lock is counted in calendar months from the rental start date, and a notice may be sent from the day the lock completes.

The rental start date is the move-in date on the company's record of that storage rental, and the notice is tied to that same rental. The number of months is the rate lock set for the space class.

*Boundary cases (hypothetical rental start date 15 March 2025, with a 12-month lock, which completes on 15 March 2026):*

| Rate notice sent | Lock completed? | May the notice be sent? |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March 2026 | no | no |
| 15 March 2026 | yes, on that day | yes |
| 2 April 2026 | yes | yes |

**Term 2 — notice period.** The notice must be sent at least the rate-increase notice number of calendar days before the first month the new rent applies. A notice records the date it is sent, the first month the new rent applies and the new monthly rent; the new rent takes effect from that month.

*Hypothetical cases with a 30-day notice period and a new rent first applying to the month that begins on 1 June:* a notice sent on 1 May (31 days before 1 June) meets the period; a notice sent on 10 May (22 days before) does not.

**Term 3 — cap.** One notice may raise rent by no more than the rate-increase cap percentage, rounded half up to the cent. The highest new rent one notice may set is the current monthly rent multiplied by one plus the cap percentage divided by one hundred, rounded half up to the cent.

*Worked figures (hypothetical inputs, cap 8 percent):*

| Current monthly rent | Current rent multiplied by 1.08 | Highest new rent one notice may set |
|---|---|---|
| 72.00 | 77.76 | 77.76 |
| 51.84 | 55.9872 | 55.99 |
| 239.00 | 258.12 | 258.12 |

A notice that sets a new rent of 77.76 on a current rent of 72.00 is within the cap; one that sets 78.00 is not.
